molecule.need: want something very much: without it, something bad happens
molecule.night: the time when it is dark
molecule.play: do things for feel-good, not for need
molecule.put: move a thing to a place and touch it there
molecule.read: see the words of a book and know them
molecule.river: water that moves on the earth
molecule.sit: the body goes down and rests on something
molecule.sleep: the body rests: eyes closed, not moving
molecule.stone: a hard thing that does not move by itself
molecule.storm: bad weather: much water and wind from the sky
molecule.sun: the bright thing above, far, that makes the day
molecule.take: touch a thing and move it to oneself
molecule.train: the big thing on rails that moves people
molecule.tree: a tall living thing with parts that are green
molecule.try: do something wanting it to work, not knowing if it can
molecule.turn: the body or a thing changes direction
molecule.way: the place where one moves from here to there
molecule.wound: the place in the body where it hurts
